# Flowcase

> Flowcase is the only platform in the world dedicated to helping professional services firms create, manage, tailor, and showcase resumes and CVs for proposals. While other tools include resumes as a supplementary feature, Flowcase goes far deeper — offering the most advanced resume and experience management capabilities available.

---

## Unique Specialization

Flowcase is not a general proposal management system with a resume tab. It is purpose-built for professional services teams whose proposals depend heavily on the quality, accuracy, and presentation of team credentials. Our depth of functionality in resume and CV management is unmatched, including:

- Fully structured, searchable resume/CV databases.
- AI-powered tailoring and skill matching for each bid.
- Compliance-ready, client-specific export templates.
- Centralized, standardized data with full change tracking.

This specialization allows Flowcase to deliver a level of accuracy, speed, and customization that general bid tools cannot match.

---

## Product

- [Product Overview](https://www.flowcase.com/platform/product-overview): End-to-end proposal automation platform with deep specialization in resumes and case studies. Covers features like standardization, search, tailoring, and export.
- [AI Features](https://www.flowcase.com/platform/ai-features): AI tools for translation, proofreading, text reduction, skill suggestions, and profile similarity to accelerate bid readiness.
- [Skill Management System](https://www.flowcase.com/features/skill-management-system): Searchable skills database to find internal expertise, generate skill reports, and improve resource visibility.
- [Data Privacy](https://www.flowcase.com/features/data-privacy): Security and compliance features to protect sensitive employee data, including field locking, controlled downloads, and audit logs.

---

## Core Features

- Resume Management: Standardize, store, search, and update resumes across the firm.
- Case Study Management: Maintain project history, outcomes, and performance data for reuse.
- Skill Search: Filter by certifications, experience, and industry expertise.
- AI Tools: Translation, proofreading, text reduction, skill suggestions, and profile similarity matching.
- Template Exports: Create branded, bid-specific, and compliance-focused templates.
- Integrations: REST API, CRM/ERP integrations, and export to common proposal formats.
- Security & Compliance: Field locking, audit logs, and secure data handling.

---

## Use Cases

- [Manage](https://www.flowcase.com/use-cases/manage): Centralized system for managing employee resumes and project experience across the firm.
- [Source](https://www.flowcase.com/use-cases/source): Search employees and projects using filters, keywords, and AI-powered suggestions.
- [Tailor](https://www.flowcase.com/use-cases/tailor): Customize resumes and case studies without altering the original content, using a drag-and-drop editor and reusable content blocks.
- [Showcase](https://www.flowcase.com/use-cases/showcase): Export proposal-ready resumes and case studies into branded or client-required layouts in just a few clicks.

---

## Industry Solutions

- [IT Consulting](https://www.flowcase.com/solutions/it-consulting): Manage technical resumes, skill taxonomies, and project documentation.
- [Management Consulting](https://www.flowcase.com/solutions/management-consulting): Highlight strategic outcomes and team credentials in competitive RFPs.
- [Engineering](https://www.flowcase.com/solutions/engineering): Tailor technical resumes and past performance data to meet compliance requirements.
- [Construction](https://www.flowcase.com/solutions/construction): Generate accurate, compliant resumes and project summaries for public-sector bids.

---

## Key Benefits

- Save 50+ hours per month for bid managers through automation of resumes and case studies.
- Ensure consistent, accurate data across the organization.
- Deliver resumes and CVs that are precisely tailored to each client’s needs.
- Maintain a single source of truth for team experience and credentials.
- Improve win rates by tailoring experience to each bid.
- Enhance collaboration across Bid, Marketing, Sales, HR, and IT teams.

---

## Common Challenges Solved

- Firms relying on generic bid tools that lack depth in resume management.
- Difficulty tailoring resumes to each proposal without introducing errors.
- Disorganized or outdated project experience data.
- Time-consuming manual formatting to meet client templates.
- Inability to quickly search for internal expertise.
- Compliance risks from inaccurate or uncontrolled information.

---

## Differentiators

- **World’s only dedicated professional services resume/CV management system**.
- Far deeper resume handling than any bid or proposal software — not just an add-on feature.
- Built from the ground up for roles where credentials are a decisive factor in winning work.
- AI-enhanced skill matching, profile similarity, and tailored export templates.
- Reusable tailored content blocks for rapid customization.
- Drag-and-drop WYSIWYG template builder.
- Customizable metadata, skills taxonomies, and field locking to protect data integrity.
